question: Show the name and theme for all concerts and the number of singers in each concert.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.concert_name ,  T2.theme ,  count(*) FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN concert AS T2 ON T1.concert_id  =  T2.concert_id GROUP BY T2.concert_id
generated_sql:
SELECT concert.concert_Name, concert.Theme, COUNT(singer_in_concert.Singer_ID) AS number_of_singers
FROM concert
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert ON concert.concert_ID = singer_in_concert.concert_ID
GROUP BY concert.concert_ID, concert.concert_Name, concert.Theme;
